title: Entropy-driven batch gap analysis and remedy plan
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: During a mixed-traffic capacity window we observed repeated short-lived 'batch gaps' where the continuous batcher failed to form useful batches for 50-300ms intervals across a subset of inference workers. Symptoms included tail latency spikes (99.9th percentile +2.8x), increased token cost due to degraded batching efficiency, and unfairness where low-priority request classes were repeatedly delayed. This ticket documents the investigation, hypotheses, temporary mitigations applied, and the longer-term remediation plan.

root_cause: Not a single bug in the coalescer loop but an emergent interaction: when request arrival patterns are highly entropic (rapidly varying inter-arrival times across priority buckets) the batcher oscillates between a short wait-for-more state and an early-flush state. This is amplified by our cooldown policy for priority demotion: the demotion timer prevents a previously high-priority slot from accepting new low-priority requests for a window, leading to slot fragmentation. Backpressure signals (queue depth-based) caused workers to briefly throttle the batcher, increasing inter-arrival variance and creating self-reinforcing gaps.
mitigations_completed: Temporarily reduced minimum batching wait (min_window_ms) from 12ms to 5ms on affected pools
Enabled more aggressive prefix KV cache on impacted model variants to reduce per-token processing cost
Tuned backpressure threshold to avoid spurious throttle during low concurrency
mitigations_planned: Implement entropy-aware pump: measure short-window inter-arrival entropy and bias timer decisions toward early-coalescence when entropy high
Introduce slot preemption: allow low-priority requests to opportunistically occupy idle slots after X ms of inactivity instead of waiting full demotion cadence
Add bounded jitter to cooldown timers to prevent synchronized slot wakeups causing oscillation
Expose per-pool 'fairness budget' metric to Console and add alert if imbalance > threshold
Create canary of adaptive strategy in runtime-1.20 on a small dedicated pool
